Name: snout-vent length
Measurement: length from tip of snout to cloacal opening

Name: hind limb (tibia)  length
Measurement: tibia length, between heel and outer surface of knee

Name: head width
Measurement: head width at widest point, generally at the level of the tympanum or jaw angle

Name: internarial distance
Measurement: distance between centers of external nares

Name: eye nare distance
Measurement: distance between anterior edge of eye opneing and center of external naris

Name: eye diameter
Measurement: distance between anterior and posterior edges of eye opening

Name: third finger diameter
Measurement: width of disc of third figner measured at a right angle to the axis of the digit

Name: fourth toe diameter
Measurement: width of disc of fourth toe measured at a right angle to the axis of the digit
